items.title: The 5 Phases of a Project Management Plan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the five project phases (PDF 16-17).

blocks.text: Project management plan paanch marahil se guzarta hai, jo kitab ki be-number figure mein dikhaye gaye hain.

items: Initiation (aaghaz): project ka khayal wazeh aur manzoor hota hai.
Planning: kaam, afraad, timelines aur kharche tay hote hain.
Execution (amal): team kaam karti aur product banati hai.
Performance monitoring (nigrani): taraqqi, kharche aur maiyar ko mansoobe se jaancha jata hai.
Project closure (ikhtitam): mukammal product hawale kar ke project band kiya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch rangeen dabbe ek qataar mein, Initiation, Planning, Execution, Performance monitoring aur Project closure, ek timeline ke oopar hain jis par 1 se 5 tak number wale nuqte hain. Har nuqte ke neeche ek card par nishan hai: bulb, checklist wala laptop, rocket, doorbeen (binoculars) aur party popper.
blocks.caption: Project management plan ke 5 marahil (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Kis marhale mein taraqqi, kharche aur maiyar ka mansoobe se muwazna hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Performance monitoring, chautha marhala, jo execution ke doran aur baad mein aur project closure se pehle aata hai.

items: Paanch marahil: initiation, planning, execution, performance monitoring, project closure.
